newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Electric signs HK$5.0 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Electric signs HK$5.0 bln loan.

text.p: The Hongkong Electric Co Ltd has signed a HK$5.0 billion term loan facility with 25 financial institutions, the company said on Monday.
The borrower increased the loan size to HK$5.0 billion from the HK$3.5 billion sought at launch after the facility was oversubscribed to HK$6.0 billion in syndication.
Tranche A of HK$2.75 billion has a tenor of seven years with a put option at the end of year five. It pays a margin of 35 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Tranche B of HK$2.25 billion has a tenor of seven years and pays a margin of 40 basis points over HIBOR.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for general corporate funding requirements.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia is the sole coordinating arranger and bookrunner of the facility.

Senior arrangers and senior lead managers are Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp, Bayerische Landesbank's Hongkong branch, Commerz (East Asia) Ltd, Hang Seng Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan's Hongkong branch, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Hongkong branch, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, BA Asia, CIBC CEF, Citicorp International and Fuji Bank.
